verdict.rationale: Sardine documents initial and ongoing daily PEP screening alongside OFAC sanctions and adverse media, with ongoing-monitoring alerts. Nothing addresses relatives and close associates (RCAs) or the source context shown for a PEP match. The AI-agent 'supporting research' and 'explainable scores' claims are scoped to sanctions screening only. Missing for 10: documented coverage of related/close associates, source-level context (profile sources, positions held) for PEP hits, PEP data depth or provider detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can identify politically exposed persons and related associates with supporting source context

citations.quote: Sardine enables you to perform both an initial screening and an ongoing daily OFAC Sanctions, PEP, and Adverse Media screening, ensuring screening on both existing and new customers.
you can also enroll users for ongoing monitoring, which means that we'll alert you if any of your customers end up on one of these lists.
